title: World in Brief
coverage_note: Source-checked early edition as of 04:00 UTC, not a complete day-end digest. Coverage is weighted toward Asia-Pacific at this early cutoff; no unsupported regional filler was added.

headline: TRUMP · XI · PUTIN
AT APEC
stories.verified_claim: Trump, Xi and Putin appeared in the APEC leaders' group photo in Shenzhen on the morning of 19 November, China time.
stories.not_claimed: No trilateral outcome, agreement, completed meeting or future event is asserted.
stories.date_basis: Event on 19 November in Shenzhen, UTC+08:00; Reuters and independent video reporting appeared before the edition cutoff.
stories.image_brief: Leaders appear together in the summit group photo in Shenzhen.

headline: CYCLONE AKVAN
NEARS INDIA
stories.verified_claim: India's weather agency tracked severe cyclonic storm Akvan northward in the Bay of Bengal in a 19 November observation and warned parts of the coast.
stories.not_claimed: Landfall is explicitly a forecast, not an event that has already happened; no casualty or damage total is given.
stories.date_basis: IMD observation at 02:30 IST and national bulletin issued at 05:30 IST on 19 November.
stories.image_brief: IMD warns coastal states; landfall remains a forecast for 20 Nov.

headline: GTA VI
stories.label: ROLLOUT BEGINS
stories.verified_claim: Regional digital access to Grand Theft Auto VI began at local midnight on 19 November, including New Zealand and India.
stories.not_claimed: No claim is made that launch has finished worldwide, or that an exact sales or revenue total is confirmed.
stories.date_basis: Observed access in New Zealand and India at local midnight on 19 November, supported by reporting beyond the previously announced schedule.
stories.image_brief: Digital access begins region by region; New Zealand and India are live.

headline: CRIMEAN BRIDGE
CLOSURE REPORTED
stories.verified_claim: Crimea's Russian-installed governor announced a temporary suspension of bridge traffic after an attack; the report remains attributed to that official.
stories.not_claimed: No independently confirmed perpetrator, new damage assessment or current reopening status is asserted.
stories.date_basis: Announcement at 01:35 UTC+03:00 on 19 November; also 00:35 in Kyiv. The UTC date was still 18 November.
stories.image_brief: Russian-installed governor reports a temporary closure after an attack.

stories.label: AUSTRALIA JOBLESS RATE
stories.verified_claim: The ABS released the seasonally adjusted October unemployment rate of 4.9% on 19 November at 11:30 AEDT.
stories.not_claimed: The rate describes October data, not one day's layoffs; seasonally adjusted and trend rates are not mixed.
stories.date_basis: New official statistical release on 19 November at 11:30 AEDT, or 00:30 UTC.
stories.image_brief: ABS released the seasonally adjusted October figure on 19 November.

headline: Ueda signals more hikes
deck: Timing depends on economic and financial conditions.
stories.image_brief: BoJ governor says timing and pace depend on economic and financial conditions.
stories.verified_claim: Ueda reiterated on 19 November that BOJ would keep raising rates in response to economic, price and financial conditions.
stories.not_claimed: No new interest-rate decision or fixed date for a future hike is asserted.
stories.date_basis: 19 November JST testimony; Reuters first publication 01:33:52 UTC.

headline: Study models malaria rollback
deck: A hypothetical low-intervention scenario, not observed cases.
stories.image_brief: Without major controls: 422m cases/year (275–582m), modelled—not observed.
stories.verified_claim: A Nature Communications study published 19 November estimates 422 million annual cases, range 275–582 million, under a hypothetical withdrawal of major interventions with other ecological/demographic conditions held constant.
stories.not_claimed: This is not a current case count, an unconditional forecast or evidence that interventions have already been withdrawn.
stories.date_basis: Journal publication 19 November; secondary report timestamp 03:00:29 UTC.

headline: Brent: $92.12 a barrel
deck: Reuters quote, 02:37 GMT; intraday, not a closing price.
stories.image_brief: Reuters quote at 02:37 GMT; intraday, not a closing price.
stories.verified_claim: Reuters reported Brent futures at US$92.12 a barrel at 02:37 GMT on 19 November.
stories.not_claimed: No closing price or independently checked same-minute exchange quote is asserted.
stories.date_basis: Dated 19 November market snapshot, report published 03:05:52 UTC.

headline: M5.7
stories.label: KUMAMOTO QUAKE
stories.verified_claim: JMA recorded a new Kumamoto earthquake at 02:22 JST on 19 November with a preliminary magnitude of 5.7.
stories.not_claimed: Magnitude is not confused with the separate Japanese intensity scale. No unverified casualty or damage count is asserted.
stories.date_basis: New earthquake at 02:22 JST on 19 November, or 17:22 UTC on 18 November; the July earthquake in the same sequence is background, not today's event.
stories.image_brief: JMA recorded the new tremor at 02:22 JST on 19 November.

headline: Fiji's first wastewater drug report
deck: Meth detected at four sampled sites; not a national prevalence estimate.
stories.image_brief: Meth detected at four sampled sites; not a national prevalence estimate.
stories.verified_claim: Fiji released its first wastewater drug monitoring findings on 19 November; reports describe meth detected at all four sample sites.
stories.not_claimed: The sampling does not show a nationwide prevalence or count of individual users; the underlying programme did not begin today.
stories.date_basis: 19 November FJT report release; two reports published 01:37:58 UTC and 02:00 UTC.

headline: Tonga declares drought emergency
deck: Nationwide emergency starts 19 November as drought strains water supplies.
stories.image_brief: Nationwide emergency starts 19 November as drought strains water supplies.
stories.verified_claim: Tonga activated a nationwide drought-related state of emergency at 11:00 Tonga time on 19 November.
stories.not_claimed: The drought itself did not begin today; no unverified loss or completed aid-delivery total is asserted.
stories.date_basis: 19 November in Tonga (UTC+13), corresponding to 18 November 22:00 UTC; new reports also dated 19 November.

headline: NZ court faults pay-equity overhaul
deck: High Court finds sex discrimination; the law remains in force.
stories.image_brief: High Court finds sex discrimination; the law remains in force.
stories.verified_claim: The New Zealand High Court declared the pay-equity restrictions inconsistent with the Bill of Rights Act; reporting says the declaration does not revoke the law.
stories.not_claimed: No claim is made that legislation was struck down, claims automatically restored, or appeals exhausted. Original judgment text was not obtained.
stories.date_basis: Judgment reported released on 19 November NZDT; RNZ first publication 01:00:29 UTC.
